static_traits.name: Li Mei
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, living in an apartment near Elementary school
static_traits.social_status: Has one close friend but has not yet shared inner feelings; has not yet disclosed worries to colleagues, worrying about being judged
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not yet received psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation; able to specifically describe time and situations; Positive attitude but with marked Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: The persistent thought 'I will be fired' appeared after starting Work at the hometown Elementary school, causing significant Anxiety and distress, especially affecting focus and performance Before work and during Work.
basic_info.core_demands: The intensity of these thoughts and their impact on my daily functioning and mental health prompted me to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not competent for this Work

special_situations.event: After just accepting Work at the hometown Elementary school, not yet started or just started performing duties
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perfectly handle the new position immediately, I will be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly self-comforting and seeking recognition from colleagues to gain certainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might be fired within a week

special_situations.event: Before work and while teaching at school
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not perform well enough, others will think hiring me was a mistake
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Highly tense at work, pursues zero errors to avoid 'failure'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will realize hiring me was a mistake

special_situations.event: Receiving positive feedback from Students, parents and colleagues but lacking negative performance evidence
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback is unreliable; only reaching perfect standards counts as safe
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive information, filters for the worst scenarios in the mind, worries repeatedly
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This praise does not count, I will be fired eventually

special_situations.event: When considering whether to share Anxiety with colleagues or friends, worrying about being judged
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose my Anxiety and uncertainty, others will look down on me, thinking I am not competent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding disclosure and help-seeking, staying silent
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will judge me, thinking I am not worthy of being competent

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, to prove oneself competent and stay safely in the position
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged and rejected, worrying about being fired, being negated as 'not good enough'
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged by staying cautious and not exposing vulnerability; seeking external recognition to temporarily ease uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough newcomer, someone who may be eliminated at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Harshly judging superiors or colleagues who may negate her at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others talk about others' evaluations, work performance, or whether to share inner feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to believe others will, like harsh judges, discover she is 'not good enough', thereby rejecting or negating her (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Validating their Anxiety in a steady, Empathic tone; using open-ended Questioning and Clarifying facts, helping distinguish speculation from evidence; avoiding confrontation and judgment.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to consider seeking support from colleagues or friends, sharing Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing expressing vulnerability will burden others and be seen as incompetent, hence should not speak up
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gently probing the worry behind 'not troubling others'; encouraging small-step sharing attempts in a supportive tone, emphasizing choosing trustworthy people and limited scope.

manifestations: Living alone, not yet sharing inner worries with colleagues or close friends
Bearing it alone in Work-related Anxiety, avoiding help-seeking

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Inner rules emphasizing one must perform perfectly
Treats 'zero errors = safety' as a rigid standard

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Worrying superiors or colleagues will think her incompetent
Fearing judgment and not daring to share feelings

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Self-evaluating as 'I am never good enough'
Excessively worrying and being cautious before work, limiting self-expression

positive_force: Receiving positive feedback from parents and colleagues (Students like her, parents give praise)
Has one close friend as a potential support resource
Positive attitude, willing to try identifying and Reinforcing positive experiences
Able to clearly describe trigger situations and automatic thoughts
negative_force: Marked tendency toward catastrophizing and predicting the future
Perfectionism pressure leads to excessively high self-demands
Excessively seeks external approval but finds it hard to stabilize self-worth
Avoids sharing and asking for help for fear of others' judgment
Sleep and diet disturbance, affecting daily functioning and Work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly worrying about being fired before and during Work with Significant anxiety
antecedent: Thinking of possible evaluations by superiors or colleagues, worried about making mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: New Work pressure and perfectionism-driven Catastrophizing and predicting the future ('I am not good enough' core belief activated)
target_behavior.function: Escaping the potential risk of being negated and failing, gaining certainty through seeking others' recognition
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep and diet rhythm disturbance; Work focus and performance affected; reduced emotional exchange with colleagues and friends
